title: Travel Completed | APPR | SELFREACC | Treated as INVOL | Promise = 14-day
description:
Airline cancelled the flight and customer used the self-service tool to rebook themselves (SELFREACC). SELFREACC is classified as INVOL � promise stays at 14-day mark. Validates that self-rebook is treated identically to airline-initiated INVOL.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Simon Lacroix), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00. Change 1: INVOL � AC cancels flight. Change 2: SELFREACC � customer self-rebooks via tool, arrival 14:00. Actual arrival: 14:00. Arrival delay code: 36 (Fuelling/Defuelling).
